name: Spider-Gwen

abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek tehlike kaçış — isabetli saldırı veya savunma yeteneği azaltan şampiyon kullan.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Web Warrior
With greater experience in the Contest, Spider-Gwen learns to do whatever a spider can and gains the following ability improvements:
Slow Debuff lasts [0.5 - 3] seconds longer.
+[27.78 - 175.53] Critical Damage Rating for each Spider-Sense charge.
Special 2 Stun reduces Power & Health gains by an extra +[5 - 70]%.
+[10 - 45]% Hunter-Spider and Trap-Spider ability duration.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Sense
content: Spider-Gwen begins each fight with 1 charge of Spider-Sense active. Each charge grants +[1,583.85] Attack Rating and a 7% chance to Evade all Champion Attacks. Max: 5 charges.
When struck 5 times, gain 1 Spider-Sense charge.
100% chance when struck by an opponent with a True Strike Buff to Nullify that Buff and gain a Spider-Sense charge.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: If fighting a Champion of the Superior Class, begin the fight with an additional 3 Spider-Sense charges.

abilitySections.title: Evade Effects
content: +550% Evade Ability Accuracy vs. Unblockable Special Attacks.
While Blocking, this Champion will not attempt to Evade.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Causes a Slow Debuff on the opponent for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Evade an Attack or Land a Combo-Ending Attack
content: Active Hunter-Spider and Trap-Spider effects have their effect duration paused for 0.5 seconds. During Special Attacks, these effects are also paused for the full duration of the attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain a Passive Trap-Spider effect for 10 seconds. This grants +[339.89] Critical Damage Rating and allows attacks a 30% chance to Enervate the opponent, preventing them from gaining Power when struck for 5 seconds.
Gain 1 Spider-Sense charge after activating this attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict a 4 second Stun Debuff.
This Stun Debuff also reduces Regeneration Rate and Combat Power Rate by 80% while active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain a Passive Hunter-Spider effect for 18 seconds, causing each attack to deal a burst of extra Physical Damage equal to 55% of Spider-Gwen's attack damage dealt.
